capability.summary: Run Ruff check in JSON mode using discovered project configuration
capability.description: Executes exactly `ruff check --output-format json <target>` and returns parsed diagnostics. The wrapper passes neither `--fix` nor `--no-fix`, so discovered configuration such as `fix=true` can modify source; it also passes no `--no-cache`, allowing Ruff's normal cache writes.
capability.problem_space: Ruff lint checking for one Python file or directory using discovered configuration, with possible configuration-driven fixes and cache writes; not a guaranteed read-only audit, explicit Ruff format workflow, Bandit security scan, type check, or test run.

env_requirements: any intended Ruff configuration must be discoverable by Ruff from the target and inherited working directory
constraint.io_signature: Input: required target_path string naming an existing file or directory. Executes `ruff check --output-format json <target>` with inherited cwd/config discovery and without `--no-fix` or `--no-cache`; configuration may enable source fixes and Ruff may write cache state. Output: JSON envelope with parsed diagnostics when valid JSON is emitted.
accepted_inputs: an existing Python source file intended for Ruff checking and authorized for possible configuration-driven modification
an existing directory tree intended for Ruff checking where normal Ruff cache writes are acceptable
constraint.output_shape: Ruff exit 0 or 1: {status: "success", tool: "ruff", target: string, exit_code: 0|1, result: array|object|scalar|null, stdout: string|null, stderr: string|null}; native JSON diagnostics normally appear as an array in result with stdout=null. Diagnostics and exit code may reflect configuration-driven fixes already applied to source, and cache writes are not reported. Other Ruff exits use status="tool_error" and propagate the exit code. Missing target, executable, or 120-second timeout: {status: "error", tool: "ruff", message: string}, exiting 2/3/4. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON.
limitations: does not pass `--no-fix`; project configuration can set `fix=true`, so the wrapper cannot guarantee source files remain unchanged
does not pass `--no-cache`; Ruff may create or update its default `.ruff_cache` or configured cache directory
uses discovered Ruff rules/configuration without exposing select, ignore, config, target-version, preview, exclude, fix, or cache controls
Ruff rule coverage differs from Flake8, Pyflakes, Bandit, type checkers, and dead-code tools; diagnostics are not security or correctness proof
uses a fixed 120-second timeout, captures output without truncation, and may preserve raw stdout if Ruff output is not one valid JSON document

output_contract.description: JSON execution envelope containing parsed Ruff check diagnostics, exit code, and raw streams; discovered configuration may enable source fixes and Ruff cache writes.

intent_tags: lint Python code with configured Ruff check
get native JSON Ruff diagnostics using project configuration
negative_intents: provide an explicit Ruff format workflow
select or disable fixes and cache behavior through manifest inputs
run Flake8 Pyflakes Bandit or a type checker
execute Python tests or prove code is secure

output_contract.description: JSON execution envelope containing parsed Ruff check diagnostics, exit code, and raw streams; discovered configuration may enable source fixes and Ruff cache writes.
